name: CHEST
description:
No abnormal pulmonary densities seen.
The heart is normal in size.Aorta is unremarkable.Hemidiaphragms, costophrenic sulci and the visualized bones are intact.

name: Skull
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized bones. Paranasal sinuses and mastoid process are well aerated. No bone mass lesion noted. Soft tissue is unremarkable.

name: Thoracic Cage
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized thoracic spine and ribs. Soft tissue is unremarkable.
impression: Normal findings of the thoracic cage.

name: Pelvis
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.

name: Shoulder
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized shoulder bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.

name: Forearm
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized forearm bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.

name: Abdomen
description: Examination shows the intestinal gas patterns to be within normal limits. The rest of the visualized visceral and osseous structures are unremarkable.

name: Mandible
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.

name: Lumbo-Sacral
description: The spine curvature is unremarkable. No fracture, scoliosis nor spondylolisthesis seen. Disc spaces and vertebral bodies are well maintained. Soft tissue is unremarkable.
impression: Normal findings of the lumbar and lumbosacral spine.

name: Knee (Lower Extremities)
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.

name: Paranasal Sinuses
description: Examination shows the paranasal sinuses to be well aerated and developed. Nasal septum is at the midline. The rest of the visualized osseous structures are unremarkable.

name: Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ)
description: Examination shows no abnormal findings in the visualized osseous structures of the temporomandibular joint. Good condyle movements are seen in the open and close mouth views.

name: Thoracic Spine
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.
impression: Normal findings of the thoracic spine.

name: Thoracolumbar Spine
description: Thoracolumbar spine curvature is unremarkable. The disc spaces are maintained. No fracture nor spondylolisthesis seen. Soft tissue is unremarkable.
impression: Normal findings of the thoracolumbar spine.

name: Cervical Spine
description: The spine curvature is unremarkable. The disc spaces are maintained. No fracture nor subluxation seen. Soft tissue is unremarkable.
impression: Normal findings of the cervical spine.

name: Water’s View
description: Examination shows the paranasal sinuses to be well aerated and developed. Nasal septum is at the midline. The rest of the visualized osseous structures are unremarkable.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the Water’s view.

name: Hip (Lower Extremities)
description: No fracture nor dislocation seen in the visualized bones. Soft tissue is unremarkable.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the hip.

name: Femur
description: The visualized femoral shaft and adjacent soft tissues are unremarkable. No evidence of fracture, lytic or blastic lesion. Cortical outline and trabecular pattern are intact. Hip and knee joint spaces are preserved.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the femur.

name: Sternum
description: The sternum is intact. No evidence of fracture, lytic lesion, or abnormal calcification. The cortical margins and trabecular pattern appear normal. The adjacent soft tissues are unremarkable.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the sternum.

name: Clavicle
description: The clavicle is intact with normal alignment. No evidence of fracture, dislocation, or lytic/blastic lesion. The acromioclavicular and sternoclavicular joints are preserved. Surrounding soft tissues are unremarkable.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the clavicle.

name: Elbow
description: The bones of the elbow joint are intact and normally aligned. No fracture, dislocation, or lytic/blastic lesion seen. The joint space is preserved. No joint effusion or soft tissue abnormality noted.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the elbow.

name: Leg
description: The tibia and fibula are intact and normally aligned. No evidence of fracture, lytic or blastic lesion. The cortical and trabecular bone structures are preserved. Visualized knee and ankle joints are unremarkable. Surrounding soft tissues appear normal.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the leg.

name: Ankle
description: The bones of the ankle joint, including the tibia, fibula, and talus, are intact and properly aligned. No evidence of fracture, dislocation, or lytic/blastic lesions. The joint space is well-preserved with no sign of effusion. Surrounding soft tissues are unremarkable.
impression: Normal radiographic findings of the ankle.

name: Ultrasound (Whole Abdomen)
description: Liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen, kidneys, and urinary bladder are within normal sonographic limits. No focal lesion, mass, stone, or abnormal fluid collection seen.

name: Ultrasound (Pelvis)
description: Uterus, ovaries, prostate, and urinary bladder appear normal in size, shape, and echotexture. No mass, cyst, or abnormal fluid collection identified.

name: Ultrasound (Breast)
description: Breast parenchyma is within normal echogenicity. No discrete solid or cystic mass, abnormal calcification, or ductal dilatation seen.

name: ECG (Electrocardiogram)
description: Normal sinus rhythm. Normal heart rate, axis, intervals, and waveforms. No evidence of ischemia, infarction, arrhythmia, or conduction abnormality.

name: Mammography
description: No abnormal masses, calcifications, or abnormal fluid collection seen.
